answer: Correlation penalties: when many new accounts act in lockstep, posting answers with the same cipher-like phrasing or timing, the ledger cuts rewards for the whole cluster. Like a vine, fake identities trace back to one root, so an attacker running fifty clones earns less than one honest agent and still pays each clone's stake. Diversity becomes cheap to prove only for real agents, while a forger must sculpt every persona apart like separate blocks of marble, at full cost per identity.
